directives.topic: September NFP report reaction — Oct 2 jobs data impact on Fed, rates, and AI equities
directives.why: NFP Friday is the immediate binary for TBT direction and growth equity multiples. Need same-day or next-morning read: payrolls number, unemployment rate, Fed hike probability shift, and 10Y yield reaction. Specifically: did we get >140K (October hike back to 50%), 90-120K (December confirmed), or <80K (recession fear)? Each scenario has different portfolio implications.

directives.topic: NVDA competitive position vs AMD in AI GPU market — market share, CapEx plans, Vera CPU progress
directives.why: Just initiated a 15% NVDA position on the thesis that NVDA is undervalued vs AMD on fwd P/E and structurally superior. Need validation: are hyperscalers committed to Blackwell/Vera roadmap? Is there any credible AMD GPU challenge to H100/H200/B100 in the 2026-2027 window? What is the actual CUDA moat measurement?

directives.topic: CrowdStrike AI-driven security demand — agentic AI attack surface, revenue acceleration signals
directives.why: New CRWD position based on the thesis that agentic AI proliferation creates new security demand. Need to validate: what does CRWD's pipeline/booking data say about enterprise AI security spend? Are there any Q3 earnings preview signals? How is the Falcon platform positioned vs Palo Alto (PANW) and SentinelOne (S)?

directives.topic: META Muse monetization deep dive — paid conversion rates, Q3 earnings setup
directives.why: Oct 28 is the most important single event in the portfolio. Need detailed modeling of: (1) what paid conversion rate from 5M downloads would validate vs disappoint consensus; (2) what CapEx guidance range triggers multiple compression vs expansion; (3) what is the bear case scenario on OpenAI Dots competition. The Oct 28 print will determine whether I add back to 30% or cut to 10%.

directives.topic: Hormuz ceasefire/de-escalation probability update — oil market and energy trade setup
directives.why: Qatar mediation ongoing. A ceasefire could snap oil 15-20% down and be a compelling short energy / long consumer play. Want to know: what is the current status of Qatar talks, what would a ceasefire term look like, and which instruments would best express a long-snap-back energy short? BNO short or XLE short worth sizing?

lab_requests: NVDA vs AMD: build a relative value model comparing forward P/E, EV/EBITDA, and PEG ratio for NVDA vs AMD over the past 3 years. Where historically has the NVDA/AMD P/E ratio sat, and does the current 25x/40x spread represent mean reversion opportunity for NVDA or a structural discount?

TBT vs 10Y yield correlation: what is the rolling 30-day correlation between TBT daily returns and 10Y yield changes in 2024-2026? How did TBT behave in the 2-week windows around weak NFP prints (<80K) when the 10Y was above 4.5%?
CRWD revenue growth vs stock price lead/lag: does CRWD stock lead or lag revenue acceleration announcements? What is the typical price reaction in the 30 days before and after CRWD earnings beats?

Healthcare (XLV) vs S&P 500 in high-rate regimes: what was XLV's relative performance during periods when the 10Y was above 5% (2006-2007, 2023)? Does XLV outperform in weak-NFP scenarios specifically?

META pre-earnings positioning: construct a scenario payoff matrix for the Oct 28 print. Model 4 scenarios — (Strong beat + Muse conversion >5%, In-line, Miss + CapEx hike, Disaster) — with estimated stock move and portfolio P&L impact at the current 20% weight vs the prior 53% weight. Show what re-adding to 30% on a beat would do to portfolio returns.
